explanation: This asks to improve the lower bound 1.292 (Piterbarg–Bajaj–Vincent 2026). Tao's page lists 1.292 with an asterisk as unverified; the last verified bound is 1.2802. If 1.292 were wrong, the interval (1.292, C_{1a}] could be empty. The question as posed is open; note the base bound is unverified.
